**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.6 is the sixth release candidate.** It brings a way to record a problem for whoever is helping you, a boot guard that no longer mistakes quick restarts for crashes, fuller hook maps for more cars (the Palisade 2023 on US 260507 among them), and wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-rc.7. 1.1.0 will be this code unless a blocker turns up. **This RC hasn't been checked on a car yet**, so please report how it goes. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release.

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.7](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.7)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**. NEMESIS in the app menu is the same as in rc.5.

## What's new since 1.1.0-rc.5

- **Record a problem** (HMG-API app → Logs → Record a problem): start it, make the problem happen (a crash, CarPlay with no sound), and stop it, for up to 30 minutes. The file goes on the USB stick and in `/data/hmgapi/public/reports/`, for whoever is helping you. It keeps only crash, CarPlay, Android Auto, audio, Bluetooth, hotspot and HMG-API log lines, scrubbed of addresses, numbers and phone ids. Crash dumps, Android's crash reports and the kernel log are each off until you turn them on. **Read the file before you send it**: CarPlay and Android Auto lines can still name your phone or what's playing.
- **The boot guard no longer turns the hooks off after quick restarts.** Restarting the head unit three times within two minutes of starting each time (an install, an apply and a restart) used to turn HMG-API's hooks off with nothing wrong. Now three failed starts within one boot still do, and full restarts only after six in a row.
- **"Install anyway" covers a mod's patch sets too.** A mod made for other cars now installs what needs no car-specific files. When a change does need one, the install stops and says the mod has no patch set for this head unit, instead of blaming a NEMESIS package.
- **More of the newest hook points, from your Car Reports:** all 391 on the Ioniq 6 260206 (Canada and US) and the Elantra (`CN7PE`) US 260507; the Genesis G70 US 260507 and Palisade US 260903 gain the points their older reports lacked; the G70 Canada 260903 gains 30.
- **A hook map for the Palisade 2023 and on, US 260507** (thanks to dweaver33).
- **A new hook point for mods:** an activity starting another (`framework.activity.start_activity_for_result`). Wireless will use it to fix the car's "connect a phone" popup on US and Canadian builds.
- **A mod's settings save themselves:** no more "Save settings" button, and pressing Apply changes right after a change no longer loses it.
- **Installing a mod from Updates no longer stops at "engine error: … rename …xml.tmp"**: only one engine run happens at a time now.
- **Home Wi-Fi's Connect now can run until you drive off:** untick "Turn off after 30 minutes".
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.6/CHANGELOG.md).

## Car Reports wanted

**One Car Report from this RC per row** maps the newest hook points (Phone Projection's service, the hotspot's settings, the car's power events), for every model in the row:

| Build | Any one of these |
|---|---|
| Hyundai Palisade 2023 and on | US 260507 or US 260903 |
| Genesis G70 | USA 260507 or Korea 260902 |
| Hyundai Ioniq 6 | US 260507, Korea 260902 or Singapore 260907 |
| Hyundai Elantra N 2024 | US 260903 |
| Hyundai, Korea 260902 | Sonata, Sonata Hybrid, Santa Fe, Palisade, Avante (`CN7` or the facelifted `CN7PE`) |
| Hyundai, India 260430 | Creta, Creta Electric |
| Kia, Korea 260902 | EV6, K3 |
| Kia EV6, India 260430 | EV6 |
| Kia Niro EV 2026, Canada 260206 | Niro EV (`SG225EV`) |

**No map yet:** the **Tucson Hybrid 2024 on US 260903** (#328). A Car Report from this RC is all it takes.

A **Check the map on this car** (HMG-API app → Settings) helps too, from any car whose map says "waiting for a check on a car". More in [#247](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/247).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta or an earlier RC:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.6-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Restart the head unit once afterwards. Your mods and settings stay. To update the wireless mod too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.7.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, pick it in Check USB updates, and **Apply changes**.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.6-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** follow [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.6-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- **After updating:** the app shows **1.1.0-rc.6** and "Hooks on" on a car that had them, and your mods still run after a restart.
- **Restart the head unit a few times in a row** right after it starts: the hooks should stay on.
- **Record a problem:** start it, use CarPlay or Android Auto for a few minutes, stop it, and check the file is on the stick and reads sensibly.
- **A mod's settings:** change one and press Apply changes straight away; the change should stick.
- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto** on a car where they worked with rc.5: music, a call, turn-by-turn on the cluster.
- **A car in the table above:** make a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report).

## Known issues

- Wireless doesn't support the Elantra (`CN7PE`) US 260507, the Sportage Plug-in Hybrid and Niro EV on Canada 260206, or the Ioniq 6 on US 260206 yet; they're coming in wireless 2.2.0-rc.8.
- Bluetooth Audio can take audio focus at a cold start before CarPlay or Android Auto is up. A fix is in review (wireless #56).
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting, so take the stick out after installing.

## Going back

- **To 1.1.0-rc.5 with adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.5-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.5-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **To 1.0.2:** as in [rc.3's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.3#going-back-to-102). Wireless 2.2.0-rc.7 needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer, so going back to 1.0.2 means going back to wireless 2.1.0 too.

## Reporting

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with your car, its head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version and your mods, and a Car Report if you can.
